rationale: Kaede helps developers build IoT and embedded solutions at Seeed Studio, while THOTA brings deep hardware expertise from PLC engineering at Hitachi with active work in RTL design and hardware synthesis. They can explore how industrial automation and embedded systems intersect, particularly around hardware-level integration for IoT applications.
intro_message: Kaede Lin, meet THOTA VENKATA SEETHA RAM MOHAN — you both work at the hardware layer and could compare notes on embedded systems and industrial control applications.
